features.heading: A whole platform, not a plugin.
features.intro: Pages, backend logic, real data, publishing, modules, AI — one product, no glue required.

editor.title: Visual page editor
editor.body: Blocks, layers, responsive devices, a full styles panel, and custom traits. Every element is editable — no cookie-cutter templates.

flows.title: Real backend flows
flows.body: Compose HTTP endpoints, database queries, branches, transforms, and API calls — as a visual flow diagram. No code.

postgres.title: Postgres in one click
postgres.body: Each project gets its own isolated schema with typed columns. Or plug in Google Sheets as a CRUD backend — zero config.

publish.title: One-click publish
publish.body: Publishing freezes a version of your pages, workflows and theme. Keep editing privately, publish when you're ready, and bring back any earlier version in one click.

ai.title: AI scaffolding
ai.body: Describe what you want to build. {app} generates the pages, database schema, and backend flows — then you refine.

modules.title: {count} ready-made features
modules.body: Auth, blog, shop, bookings, forum, radio — each ships real database tables, backend flows, and pages. One click to install.

domains.title: Custom domains
domains.bodyAutoTls: Bring your own domain: add two DNS records and it's live, with a secure HTTPS certificate set up automatically.
domains.body: Bring your own domain: add two DNS records and check the connection from your dashboard.

sheets.title: Google Sheets adapter
sheets.body: Treat any spreadsheet as a database. Read, write, and query rows — no migration, no DevOps, no setup.

pricing.heading: Room for your next idea.
pricing.intro: Choose the plan that fits what you want to build.

noCode.q: Is this real no-code, or will I need to write code eventually?
noCode.a: Real no-code. The UI editor and the flow engine cover pages and backend logic end-to-end. You can embed snippets of HTML if you want to, but nothing in the product requires you to read or write code.

data.q: Where does my data actually live?
data.a: If you use the built-in Postgres data source, each project gets its own isolated schema on this installation’s PostgreSQL database. You can also bring your own Postgres via a connection string, or connect a Google Sheet. Your data, your choice.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain?
domain.a: Yes. Add a domain, verify it with a DNS TXT record, and {app} routes traffic to your project.

export.q: Can I export what I build?
export.a: You can export the HTML and CSS of any page, and download your Postgres data at any time. Flows are stored as a portable JSON graph you can take with you.

webflow.q: How are you different from Webflow or Framer?
webflow.a: Those are page builders. {app} is an app builder: beyond pages, you get a real visual backend-logic engine, first-class data sources, and runtime flows that actually execute.

bubble.q: How are you different from Bubble or Adalo?
bubble.a: Describe your app in a sentence and {app} builds the pages, the database tables and the backend workflows for you — then you keep editing visually. Your data lives in a standard Postgres database you can export at any time.

cta.heading: Build the thing you've been <accent>putting off.</accent>
cta.body: Stop wrestling with half-finished no-code tools that fall apart the moment you need real logic. {app} gives you the UI, the backend, and the data — all visual.

footer.tagline: The visual app builder with a real backend. Ship complete products — not marketing pages.
